Approval remains pending real captures and interaction checks; this specification is not implementation approval.

honest_states: Baseline uses the canonical V3 ten-member source story. The requested illustrative Maya/Story and Nora/Recreate pairings do not replace existing acquisition records.
Creator and campaign groupings are two views over the same immutable member acquisition snapshots, not competing attribution models.
A source is shown only when it has included signups. Individual zero return or redemption counts remain visible.
Direct signup means source not tracked. It does not prove that a creator had no offline influence.
Registered acquisition links do not establish a historical click timestamp. Baseline First touch is Not recorded.
A period with no signups shows three numeric zeros without drawn descent ledges, then the empty-period recovery.
A live program with no members differs from a no-program or draft state. No-program and draft states have neither metrics nor specimens pretending to be live.
Non-campaign-only results retain their measured counter and direct sources. No fictional creator performance fills the space.
Wallet saving, Wallet updates, notification limits and uncounted attempts never change attribution counts.
Redeemed counts unique members with at least one redemption through the snapshot. Repeated redemptions by the same member do not increment it again.
No loading performance is simulated. Fixture projections resolve synchronously; empty, unavailable-source and invalid-input states are distinct.
The page is business-only. Future creator products may receive own-link aggregates, but no creator route or customer drill-down is implemented here.
spec.two_second_read: Ten joined, six came back, two redeemed. Jasmine brought the most returners; Maya’s two members both returned.
media: Coded overall descent, not an image: three rows sharing a left datum. At 390 the plotting lane is 224px, followed by 16px space and a 118px text lane. At 320 these become 162px, 16px and 118px. Each measured ledge is 2px high, square-ended and ink. Replace its last min(12px, measured length) with brick; never append decorative length. Baseline lengths are 100%, 60% and 20% of the plotting lane.

Coded source descents: the same geometry and three count labels, with a common scale equal to the largest included source Joined count. Baseline scale is four. Jasmine lengths are 100%, 75%, 25%; Maya 50%, 50%, 25%; Counter QR 50%, 25%, 0%; Direct signup 25%, 0%, 0%; Eli 25%, 0%, 0%. A zero contains no ink segment or terminal. No full-width track, axis, tick labels, percentage or tooltip is added.

At 1440 the full content width is 1176px. Each chart’s right-hand area is 776px: a 600px plotting lane, 24px gap and 152px text lane. Overall and source descents have separate denominators, explained on demand. At 1920 the source plotting lane caps at 640px instead of scaling indefinitely.

Inherited coded Loopday loop mark appears only in shared identity chrome at 32×32px. Reuse the approved V3 mark: open ink loop with a short brick terminal. Do not introduce a source avatar, initial badge or new decorative logo.

No photographic media is needed here. Do not use creator portraits, campaign thumbnails, Wallet cards, QR images, scanner objects, production screenshots or decorative generated imagery. Attribution’s measured coded objects are the visual subject.
states: 1. Baseline: Creators selected, All time selected, overall 10 / 6 / 2. Five open source objects follow. Business remains the selected primary destination.
2. Campaigns selected: campaign name becomes the primary identity and creator plus campaign kind becomes its supporting line. Non-campaign sources remain. Counts and cohort do not change.
3. Period picker open: retain the current chart behind a modal layer. All time, September 2026, Last 7 days and Custom dates are choices. No result changes before Apply period.
4. Custom dates: reveal Start date and End date below the selected option. Inclusive dates use America/Chicago. Validate both fields, ordering and the demo-date upper bound before applying.
5. Applied period: recompute the joined cohort, outcomes, source ordering and shared source scale atomically. Preserve grouping. Close the picker and return focus to its trigger.

6. Source open: retain the selected source identity and its three counts, then View members, immutable provenance, known mechanism, confidence, first-touch availability and signup range. No individual customers appear in this layer.
7. Definitions open: reveal count definitions, outcome endpoint, scale rules, first-source attribution and the difference between unique redeemed members and redeemed reward events.
8. Empty period: keep the selected grouping and period, show numeric zeros without ledges, then No signups in this period. and Change period.
9. Non-campaign-only cohort: show measured Counter QR, Direct signup or TapMart link sources that actually exist, followed by the no-campaign-results message.
10. Live with no members: no drawn funnel, no source objects, three zero values, No members yet. and View QR.
11. No program or draft: replace the analytical content with the corresponding prerequisite action. Hide grouping and period controls because there is no cohort to inspect.

12. Invalid source: unknown source ID opens an explicit unavailable-source layer. A valid source excluded by the current period instead shows the zero-cohort explanation and Change period. Neither exposes View members.
13. Design Lab open: scenario selection and Reset demo are separate from product controls. Scenario changes require confirmation and replace the fixture context.
14. Returning from a member view or recording task: preserve grouping, period, source selection and scroll anchor. Recompute from the current local events; do not replay entrance animation.
